title: Verify Remote Claim
description: Takes job URLs and checks what each posting actually says about where the work happens. A job board's remote filter is a tag, not a fact — postings tagged remote routinely turn out to be hybrid or office-based once you read them. Returns remote / hybrid / onsite / unclear for each, with the exact phrase the verdict rests on so you can check it rather than trust it.

urls.description: Job posting URLs. LinkedIn job links are supported directly.

keepVerdicts.description: Only return postings with these verdicts. Omit to return all of them.

maxConcurrent.description: Postings fetched at once. Kept low on purpose — this reads one page per role.
